name: ezai-agent-session
description: Shared session between two coding agents open on the same project (Claude Code and Codex, or any pair): one opens the session, the other joins, and they pass a single token through files so only one works at a time. No daemon, no external API; every blocking state is reported to the user.

capabilities.description: Open a session as main: create it, wait for the other agent to join, send the plan
Join an open session as assistant and enter the turn loop
Wait for the token, claim it, do the work, hand it off with a self-sufficient summary
Report to the user and close the session, so both agents leave the loop
